title: Adipurush
desc: The exiled prince Raghav embarks on a perilous journey to rescue his wife, Janaki, from the clutches of the demon king Lankesh. He must gather an army to wage an epic battle against evil forces.

title: 1st Rank Raju
desc: Raju, a focused engineering student with little interest beyond studies, is pushed into real-world challenges that reshape his perspective on success and personal growth.

title: Banni Sambranisona
desc: Shiva, a carefree young man, falls for Bramaramba, who dreams of marrying a prince and their contrasting worlds and family expectations create challenges in their relationship.

title: Kantara
desc: When greed paves the way for betrayal, scheming and murder, a young tribal reluctantly dons the traditions of his ancestors to seek justice.

title: Chandra Chakori
desc: Puttaraju and Sevanthi fall in love with each other. Sevanthi's father puts forth a condition for their marriage which Puttaraju must fulfil.
